comment: kiln.gamedata (in kiln-content.dll): template clones. RegisterTemplateInfo (server 0x6671d0, client 0x9cb140) is the function the per-world template-info init (0x667c10 / 0x9cbb80) calls for every TemplateResource: (storage holder = world + world.storage, const TemplateResource* data, const Guid*, bool force) -> TemplateInfo*. Its TemplateInfo array is inline in the storage (tmpl.array: {data, count +tarr.count, cap +tarr.cap, grow callback}); growing it moves the array, so Kiln only appends while count < cap. Everything else (resource lookups) uses the assets.resources feature or kiln.assets. Evidence: docs/re/gamedata.md (clones). Buff clones: GetBuffType (server 0x933700 / client 0xe8c5c0 on svn 1287369) is getBuffType(u32 buffTypeId, BuffRegistry*) -> BuffType*: it reads the collection through BuffRegistry+buffreg.collection (the static hash map and the records); Kiln finds that slot at run time (the qword that holds the collection resource) and checks it against this constant when the sigdb has it; the symbol itself is only used for the self-check that the game's own lookup finds a clone (feature gamedata.buff_lookup, optional).
